instruction: What is attention in machine learning?
response: Attention is a mechanism that allows neural networks to focus on relevant parts of the input when processing data. Self-attention is the core mechanism in transformer models.
A language model is a system that predicts the probability of sequences of words. It learns patterns in text data and can generate new text that follows those patterns.
Tokenization is the process of breaking text into smaller units called tokens. These tokens can be words, subwords, or characters that a model can process.
BPE stands for Byte Pair Encoding. It is a subword tokenization algorithm that iteratively merges the most frequent pairs of characters or character sequences.
Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used to train machine learning models. It iteratively adjusts model parameters to minimize a loss function.
Backpropagation is an algorithm for computing gradients in neural networks. It efficiently calculates how much each weight contributes to the error by working backwards through the network.

instruction: What makes you different from other AI models?

Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, including its noise and outliers, and performs poorly on new unseen data.
A loss function measures how far a model's predictions are from the actual target values. Training aims to minimize this loss.
Softmax converts a vector of numbers into a probability distribution. It is commonly used in the output layer of classification models and in attention mechanisms.
Embeddings are dense vector representations that map discrete tokens like words into continuous space where similar items are closer together.
Transfer learning is a technique where a model trained on one task is adapted for a different but related task. It helps when you have limited data for the target task.
Fine-tuning is the process of taking a pre-trained model and training it further on a specific dataset or task to adapt it for that purpose.
An epoch is one complete pass through the entire training dataset. Models are typically trained for multiple epochs.

instruction: What is a batch in training?
response: A batch is a subset of training data processed together in one step. Using batches instead of individual samples makes training more efficient.
Mixed precision training uses both 16-bit and 32-bit floating point numbers during training. It speeds up computation and reduces memory usage on modern GPUs.

The transformer architecture that I am based on was introduced in 2017. Since then it has revolutionized natural language processing and many other fields of AI.
GELU stands for Gaussian Error Linear Unit. It is an activation function commonly used in transformer models that provides smooth non-linearity.
Layer normalization normalizes the inputs across the features for each training example. It helps stabilize training in deep neural networks.
Weight decay is a regularization technique that adds a penalty term to the loss function based on the magnitude of model weights, helping prevent overfitting.
The learning rate controls how much the model weights are updated during each training step. Too high causes instability, too low causes slow convergence.
Cosine annealing is a learning rate schedule that decreases the learning rate following a cosine curve, allowing the model to converge smoothly.
I generate text one token at a time. At each step I predict the probability of the next token and sample from those probabilities.

instruction: What is temperature in text generation?
response: Temperature controls the randomness of text generation. Lower values make outputs more focused and deterministic, while higher values increase diversity and creativity.
Top-k sampling limits text generation to only consider the k most likely next tokens. This prevents the model from choosing very unlikely words.
Top-p sampling, also called nucleus sampling, selects from the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds p.
Causal attention, also called masked attention, prevents each position from attending to future positions. This ensures the model generates text left to right.

Unsupervised learning trains models on data without labels. The model discovers patterns and structure in the data on its own.
Reinforcement learning trains agents to make decisions by rewarding desired behaviors and penalizing undesired ones. The agent learns through trial and error.

instruction: What is a neural network layer?
response: A layer is a set of neurons that processes input and produces output. Deep neural networks stack many layers to learn increasingly complex representations.
GPU acceleration uses graphics processing units to speed up mathematical computations. GPUs can perform many parallel operations, making them ideal for training neural networks.
CUDA is a parallel computing platform by NVIDIA that allows developers to use GPUs for general-purpose computing, including training machine learning models.
Hugging Face is a company and open-source platform that provides tools and models for natural language processing, including the Transformers library.
The attention mechanism computes weighted sums of values based on how relevant each key is to a query. In self-attention, queries, keys and values all come from the same input.
A decoder-only model generates text autoregressively, predicting one token at a time based on all previous tokens. GPT and I are examples of decoder-only architectures.
Perplexity is a metric for evaluating language models. Lower perplexity means the model is better at predicting the next word. It is the exponentiation of the cross-entropy loss.
